description: This circular walk from the village of Whiteparish climbs to Dean Hill and Pepperbox Hill near Salisbury in Wiltshire. The walk runs for about 7 miles and includes some moderate climbs. From the high points you are rewarded with some splendid views over the Wiltshire countryside and hills.The Pepperbox Hill area includes a 17th century folly and a nature reserve where you can look out for lots of interesting flora and fauna.After your walk you can enjoy some refreshments atThe King's Headin Whiteparish. They serve good food and can be found at postcode SP5 2SG. The pub is dog friendly.
